item.title: Fulton Sheen and the Conscience of the West
item.description: The soon-to-be-beatified archbishop's insights highlight the need to protect human dignity against communism and materialism.

item.title: The EU's Stealth Censorship Playbook
item.description: Controlling which media outlets appear at the top of social media feeds is a subtle way to silence dissenting views.

item.title: Logger-turned-lawmaker Troy Jackson claims Maine Senate nomination to replace Platner
item.description: Former state lawmaker Troy Jackson won the Democratic nomination for Maine's U.S. Senate seat on Saturday, ending nearly three weeks of political uncertainty.

item.title: Khanna joins Mamdani in calling for Netanyahu's arrest in U.S.
item.description: Rep. Ro Khanna echoed New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani's call for the arrest of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu in the United States.
